'''Jullisa Senerio''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Freliq]], and was the daughter of the farmer [[Yasil Senerio]]. One day, while out playing, she accidentally slipped of a ledge, but managed to grab a plank of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] and hold on. Her father came running to her after hearing her scream, but a roaming [[lepusa]] got there first. The creature took a rope made of vine and lowered it down to the hanging Jullisa, saving her life.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
